newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard unit sues Allegiance unit.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard unit sues Allegiance unit.

text.p: Davol Inc, a unit of C.R. Bard Inc, has filed a lawsuit against an Allegiance Corp unit, alleging infringement on two Bard patents for probes used in surgical procedures.

In papers filed last week in the U.S. District Court in Delaware, Davol alleges its '494 probe patent and '977 probe adapter patent were infringed by Allegiance Healthcare Corp products and by its distributor and co-defendant, Surgin Surgical Instrumentation Inc.
Allegiance Corp, a Chicago-based provider of health-care products and cost-management services, was spun off by Baxter International Inc last year.
Davol, based in Cranston, Rhode Island, makes laparoscopic, or minimally invasive, surgical instruments.
An Allegiance spokesman declined to comment on the lawsuit until it was served. But he told Reuters that Allegiance recently agreed to buy Surgin's trumpeter valve product line.
